_doc: Notes of the Okafor farm (Larch Hollow). The family's earlier letter is okafor_letter in pell_crossing.json.

defs.title: Ife's Journal
defs.author: Ifeoma Okafor
defs.body:
Oct 3. Tom Merrow came up from town with a truckload of plywood. He and Papa did the front windows and the front door. Papa says it's the mine. Tom says it's the government. The cows won't go near the north stalls.

Oct 9. Something in the barn last night. Papa took the shotgun. Two shots, then nothing, then Papa walking back across the yard holding his arm. He says it was a man. He says the man had moss in his mouth.

Oct 11. Fever. I put him in his own bed downstairs. He called me by Mama's name.

Oct 13. He doesn't answer to anything now. Tom helped me nail his door, then went home to Dana and the kids. I can hear Papa walking. Round and round the bed.

Oct 15. Carried everything down to the cellar: the jars, the potatoes, the last of the flour, Papa's strongbox. Padlocked the store room. Pulled the nails back out of the hatch so I can get down there, and put the bolt on the pantry door instead. The key's where Papa kept his shells.

Oct 21. Six days of rain. The bathroom ceiling has dripped since August and tonight it came through into the parlour, tub and all.

Oct 22. He isn't walking any more. He's digging. Under the bed, where the boards were always soft.

Oct 23. (pressed through the paper) He's in the cellar. He's in the cellar with everything we have.

defs.title: Note for Chidi
defs.author: Ife
defs.body:
Chidi,
Everything I could save is on these shelves. Peaches on the top, then beets, then the jam Mama made the summer you left. Papa's strongbox is under the bottom shelf; it's your birthday, like always.
Don't come up through the pantry if you hear him walking. Go round.
I'm going down to the Merrows' in the morning. If I'm not there I'm at the ranger station with Ray Hale. Don't stay here after dark.
- Ife

defs.title: Milk Ledger
defs.author: E. Okafor
defs.body:
SEPT 28  12 head  46 gal. Cooler compressor out again.
OCT 1  11 head  38 gal. Daisy off her feed.
OCT 4  9 head  30 gal. Two heifers gone from the north stalls, gate still latched. Truck didn't come. Poured it out.
OCT 6  Stopped milking the north end. They won't let me near.
OCT 7  Something walks in the loft at night. Hay comes down through the chute when nobody's up there.
OCT 8  Set the big trap in the aisle. Locked the tack room, the key's on the nail over the feed bins where Ife can find it. Going up tonight with the gun.

(The rest of the page is blank.)
